text: {"name": "scan_process_packet_queue", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Process a BLE scan RX packet queue by initializing queue descriptors, dispatching received LL PDUs, encoding per-entry status words by advertising/scan PDU type, and advancing scan advertising parameters.", "subsystem": "ble", "var_renames": {"v1": "pending_packet_count", "v3": "pending_packet_count_minus_1", "v4": "queue_entry_ptr", "v5": "last_entry_index", "v7": "ll_pdu_type", "v8": "entry_status_word", "v9": "entry_index"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 10, "meaning": "uint16_t status word of first queue entry (initialized to -1, later set to dispatch result or encoded PDU status)"}, {"offset": 169, "meaning": "uint8_t current BLE LL PDU/advertising type selector (switched over cases 0..5)"}, {"offset": 170, "meaning": "indexed byte/uint16 table used by ADV/SCAN PDU handling, accessed via offset+180"}, {"offset": 178, "meaning": "uint8_t packet status/flag byte contributing to low bits of entry_status_word"}, {"offset": 179, "meaning": "uint8_t packet status byte shifted into bit 7 of entry_status_word"}, {"offset": 180, "meaning": "uint8_t index into table at offset 170; selects rate/channel/subfield bits"}, {"offset": 181, "meaning": "uint8_t packet status byte shifted into bit 9 of entry_status_word"}, {"offset": 182, "meaning": "uint8_t packet status byte shifted into bit 10 of entry_status_word"}, {"offset": 184, "meaning": "uint16_t pending packet/queue-entry count for the scan RX queue"}]}
